agent.problem: None of the stop's four choice cards can be reasoned out from the earlier cards. Card 3 gives no basis for choosing among the three sets of gods, card 5 does not establish whether serving those gods replaced or accompanied serving the LORD, card 7 gives no clue to the identity of the two nations, and card 8 asks for an unseen number. A few discovery questions are allowed, but an entire stop of them makes this stretch a guessing game rather than mostly informed guesses.

rule.text: If the only way to get it right is luck, give the story card more context or ask a different question. A few discovery questions are fine. Some moments can't be reasoned out, like where Jonah's ship is headed. A few of those are okay, as long as most choice cards are informed guesses.

rule.text: Every Bible fact he states carries its reference.
